import sys, time, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import te.engine.qp as QP
import te.engine.worker as W
counts=[]
orig=QP._active_set
def wrap_as(*a,**k):
    t=time.time(); r=orig(*a,**k); counts.append((len(a[1]), len(a[3]), a[4], time.time()-t, not r[4]))
    return r
QP._active_set=wrap_as
orig_repair=QP._repair
rcounts=[]
def wrap_rp(*a,**k):
    t=time.time(); r=orig_repair(*a,**k); rcounts.append((len(a[1]), a[4], time.time()-t))
    return r
QP._repair=wrap_rp
import stress_worker
stress_worker.BIG=True
rng=random.Random(9)
t0=time.time()
for i in range(1500):
    owned,paths,caps,demand,mode,rho,B=stress_worker.gen_problem(rng)
    W.solve_worker(owned,paths,caps,demand,mode,rho,B)
print("active_set calls",len(counts),"repair calls",len(rcounts),"total %.1fs"%(time.time()-t0))
if counts:
    print("max time in active_set %.3f"%max(c[3] for c in counts))
    print("non-converged:",sum(1 for c in counts if c[4]))
if rcounts:
    print("repair: max time %.3f, count %d"%(max(c[2] for c in rcounts), len(rcounts)))
# worst n
print("max n", max((c[0] for c in counts), default=0))
